prompts.0: What did you learn from your last piece?
prompts.1: Who are you trying to reach today?
prompts.2: What would make this idea sharper?
prompts.3: What is the one sentence at the heart of this?
prompts.4: Is there a card that deserves a peer?
prompts.5: What would you cut if you had to?
prompts.6: Flip it: what if the audience were the exact opposite?
prompts.7: What is the biggest risk in this idea? Write it down.
prompts.8: Split it into three sub-questions — one card each.
prompts.9: What is the least intuitive assumption here? Worth testing?
prompts.10: If this idea were wrong, what would the opposite look like?
prompts.11: Which small detail is easiest to miss, yet matters most?
